brand-soft.note: Light-theme --brand-soft: soft periwinkle tint for subtle fills. In dark theme, --brand takes this value (#b5bedd) and --brand-soft becomes #5a2a40 (Deep Plum Mist).

headline.purpose: Page titles and major section headers. Set in Ink Plum, used once per screen.

body.purpose: All prose, labels, and UI copy. The default for everything that is not a number or a header.

label.purpose: Form labels, table column headers, chip text, and status badge copy.

mono.purpose: Invoice amounts, totals, IDs, dates used as sort keys. Always paired with tabular-nums.

shadows.name: shadow-float
shadows.purpose: To be defined when the first floating layer (dropdown, dialog, toast) is built. Must be diffuse, low-opacity, single-direction. Add as --shadow-float in _tokens.scss with both light and dark values.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (hover, focus). Duration: 150ms for colour/opacity, 200ms for layout.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Single container max-width. No responsive breakpoints defined yet; product is desktop-first.

darkTheme.note: Dark theme is implemented via @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) in _tokens.scss. All --bg, --surface, --surface-soft, --border, --text, --text-muted, --brand, --brand-soft, --positive, --negative, --warning values invert. See _tokens.scss for exact dark values.

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Inline validation status indicator. Pairs a colour dot with a text label — colour is never the sole signal.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid #ead7c0; border-radius: 999px; background: #ffffff; color: #6b5560; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-status::before { content: ''; flex-shrink: 0; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #6b5560; } .ds-status--up::before { background: #1e7a46; } .ds-status--down::before { background: #b42318; } .ds-status--warning::before { background: #b45309; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The primary action trigger. Ink Plum background, used sparingly — one per screen section.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; background: #470b24; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.5; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: outline-offset 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #470b24; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.85; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action. White surface, Ink Plum text, 1px border stroke.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; background: #ffffff; color: #470b24; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.5; border: 1px solid #ead7c0; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #470b24; background: #fff8ee; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #470b24; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #ffedd5; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form input. Warm tan border, Ink Plum focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-field__label { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; color: #2b0a17; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-input { padding: 8px 12px; background: #ffffff; color: #2b0a17; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; border: 1px solid #ead7c0; border-radius: 6px; outline: none; width: 100%; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #470b24; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #470b24; outline: 2px solid #470b24; outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b5560; }

components.name: Amount Display
components.description: Tabular monetary value. IBM Plex Mono ensures column alignment. Used for all invoice amounts, totals, and subtotals.
components.css: .ds-amount { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; color: #2b0a17; }

components.name: Table Row (hover state)
components.description: Invoice list row. Peach Tint hover — no shadow, no border shift. The primary data display surface.
components.html: INV-2024-001Acme Supplies$4,200.00Approved
components.css: .ds-row { background: #ffffff; border-bottom: 1px solid #ead7c0; transition: background 0.1s; } .ds-row:hover { background: #ffedd5; } .ds-cell { padding: 12px 16px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #2b0a17; vertical-align: middle; } .ds-cell--amount { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; }

narrative.overview:
InvoiceIQ is built on the conviction that every figure deserves scrutiny before it moves. The design system embodies that conviction: unhurried, typographic, and precise. Where most finance tools reach for cold blue authority, this system uses warm parchment and deep plum — the palette of ink on paper, of an auditor working methodically through a stack. Nothing is decorative. Every colour, weight, and spacing decision earns its place by clarifying a number or a decision.

The interface operates at high density without noise. IBM Plex Sans supplies legibility at the 15px base; IBM Plex Mono makes monetary values and codes tabular, scannable, and unambiguous at a glance. The two faces work as a pair: the sans for context, the mono for fact. Status communicates through text labels and shape, never through colour alone — a rule that holds in both light and dark.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, parchment-grounded palette — not cold blue or sterile white
Ink Plum brand accent used sparingly — titles, primary actions, active navigation only
IBM Plex Sans + IBM Plex Mono as a committed typographic pair
Flat-tonal depth: background tiers and 1px borders, no shadows on static elements
Status communicated by text + icon shape, never colour alone
Single global radius (6px) with pill only for status badges

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Ink Plum (--brand) is the only accent. It never signals validation status — that job belongs to Forest Green, Deep Red, and Amber exclusively. If a colour is doing two jobs, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Never-Colour-Alone Rule
rules.body: No validation state is communicated by colour alone. Every status badge pairs a colour dot with a text label. This holds in both themes and in print.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Facts Rule
rules.body: Any value that will be compared, summed, or scanned in a column uses IBM Plex Mono with tabular-nums. A proportional-width amount in an amount column is a typographic error.

rules.name: The Floor-and-Border Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from background colour and border lines, not from shadows. A card is white on parchment with a tan border. That is sufficient and intentional. Shadows on cards are a regression, not an enhancement.

dos: Do use IBM Plex Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums for every monetary value, invoice ID, and date used as a sort key.
Do pair every status colour with a text label or labelled icon — colour alone never carries meaning.
Do use Ink Plum (--brand) only on primary actions, page titles, and active navigation — keep it rare so it retains authority.
Do express depth through the bg → surface → surface-soft tier progression and 1px --border lines.
Do apply WCAG 2.1 AA contrast (4.5:1 minimum) in both light and dark themes before shipping any new colour assignment.
donts: Don't use gradients, drop-shadows, or blurs on cards, table rows, buttons, or static containers.
Don't use --brand to signal a validation status — Ink Plum is brand authority, not an outcome indicator.
Don't introduce a new colour outside the token file. If a semantic need arises, add a token to _tokens.scss with both light and dark values.
Don't let a numeric column go without tabular-nums — misaligned amounts in an invoice table are a trust failure.
